evals.prompt: Initialize a recap file for the 'session-memory-pipeline' feature.
evals.expected_output: Creates recap.md with header '# Recap — session-memory-pipeline' and maintenance comment.
expectations: SKILL.md documents recap.md as the output file
recap.sh init creates the file and is idempotent (running twice = no-op)

evals.prompt: After sdd-execute completes task 'implement-schema' in WP wp-02 with result ok, record it in the feature recap.
evals.expected_output: Appends a task row under ## wp-02 with the task slug, short commit hash, and result 'ok'. If wp-02 section is absent it is created.
expectations: commit hash is sourced from git rev-parse --short HEAD
same task called twice produces exactly one row (idempotency)

evals.prompt: sdd-execute re-ran task 'run-tests' in wp-03 for the second time because the first attempt failed with a timeout. Record this loop-back.
evals.expected_output: Adds a Loop-backs: entry: '- iter 2: timeout (re-executed run-tests)' under the wp-03 section.
expectations: SKILL.md explains loop-back semantics in the recap.md section model
Loop-backs: block is created if absent; entries are appended, not overwritten

evals.prompt: wp-01 finished with one loop-back. Finalize it with status yellow and summary 'all tasks verified after retry'.
evals.expected_output: Writes 'Status: yellow — all tasks verified after retry' in the wp-01 section. Running finalize twice updates the line in place without duplicating it.
expectations: Status line is unique per WP (idempotent update)

evals.prompt: All WPs for feature 'sdd-orchestration-layer' are finalized. Generate the feature rollup.
evals.expected_output: Rewrites ## Feature rollup with counts: e.g. '3 green, 1 yellow, 0 red (of 4 WPs)'. Running rollup twice produces the same section (idempotent).
expectations: rollup counts are derived from per-WP Status lines
## Feature rollup is always the last section
rollup is idempotent (single section regardless of how many times called)

evals.prompt: Run the recap.sh --self-test flag to verify the full lifecycle.
evals.expected_output: All self-test assertions pass; script exits 0.
expectations: self-test covers init, append-task, append-task idempotency, append-loopback, finalize, finalize idempotency, rollup, rollup idempotency
